answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 7925 Country: United Kingdom Title: Q1-Is it alright to keep a boys name Fiyaz? and what does it mean? Q2-Is it alright to keep a boys name Fyaz? and what does it mean? Q3-Is it alright to keep a girls name Isha? and what does it mean? Question: Assalamualaikum Q1-Is it alright to keep a boys name Fiyaz? and what does it mean? Q2-Is it alright to keep a boys name Fyaz? and what does it mean? Q3-Is it alright to keep a girls name Isha? and what does it mean? Answer ID: 7925 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1610/1527=D /1429) (1)The name Fyaz ( فیاض ) is good, there is no wrong to keep this name. It means: generous and benefactor. (2) Aaishs ( عائشہ ) is a very favourite name. It is the name of one of the holy wives of the Prophet ( صلي الله عليه وسلم ) and the daughter of Hadhrat Abu Bakar ( رضی اللہ عنہ ). No doubt, it is very blessing and good name. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
